verdict.rationale: The pack shows reusable workflows for repeatable work and background cloud agents for bug backlogs, but neither describes scheduling jobs to run on a recurring timer or cron. A reusable workflow that is triggered on demand is not a recurring schedule, so this adjacent capability earns no credit. Scheduling is a fair axis for an AI-agent development platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
